03 / How it works

From a stream to a product.

Start with what you know. Fabbrica connects the people, decisions, and production steps that take it the rest of the way.

01

Share your brief.

Bring the idea, the references, and the audience. Begin in a private room or make the session part of the show.

02

We build your pipeline.

Shape the object, define the right fabrication path, and bring every sample, specification, and decision into view.

03

Make. Sell. Repeat.

Approve the run, open the drop, follow fulfillment, and carry what worked into the next creation.
